# Data Visualization Skill

Chart selection guidance, Python visualization code patterns, design principles, and accessibility considerations for creating effective data visualizations.

## Chart Selection Guide

### Choose by Data Relationship

| What You're Showing | Best Chart | Alternatives |
|---|---|---|
| **Trend over time** | Line chart | Area chart (if showing cumulative or composition) |
| **Comparison across categories** | Vertical bar chart | Horizontal bar (many categories), lollipop chart |
| **Ranking** | Horizontal bar chart | Dot plot, slope chart (comparing two periods) |
| **Part-to-whole composition** | Stacked bar chart | Treemap (hierarchical), waffle chart |
| **Composition over time** | Stacked area chart | 100% stacked bar (for proportion focus) |
| **Distribution** | Histogram | Box plot (comparing groups), violin plot, strip plot |
| **Correlation (2 variables)** | Scatter plot | Bubble chart (add 3rd variable as size) |
| **Correlation (many variables)** | Heatmap (correlation matrix) | Pair plot |
| **Geographic patterns** | Choropleth map | Bubble map, hex map |
| **Flow / process** | Sankey diagram | Funnel chart (sequential stages) |
| **Relationship network** | Network graph | Chord diagram |
| **Performance vs. target** | Bullet chart | Gauge (single KPI only) |
| **Multiple KPIs at once** | Small multiples | Dashboard with separate charts |

### When NOT to Use Certain Charts

- **Pie charts**: Avoid unless <6 categories and exact proportions matter less than rough comparison. Humans are bad at comparing angles. Use bar charts instead.
- **3D charts**: Never. They distort perception and add no information.
- **Dual-axis charts**: Use cautiously. They can mislead by implying correlation. Clearly label both axes if used.
- **Stacked bar (many categories)**: Hard to compare middle segments. Use small multiples or grouped bars instead.
- **Donut charts**: Slightly better than pie charts but same fundamental issues. Use for single KPI display at most.

## Python Visualization Code Patterns

### Setup and Style

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Professional style setup
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (10, 6),
    'figure.dpi': 150,
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 14,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.titlesize': 16,
})

# Colorblind-friendly palettes
PALETTE_CATEGORICAL = ['#4C72B0', '#DD8452', '#55A868', '#C44E52', '#8172B3', '#937860']
PALETTE_SEQUENTIAL = 'YlOrRd'
PALETTE_DIVERGING = 'RdBu_r'
```

### Line Chart (Time Series)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

for label, group in df.groupby('category'):
    ax.plot(group['date'], group['value'], label=label, linewidth=2)

ax.set_title('Metric Trend by Category', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Value')
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Format dates on x-axis
fig.autofmt_xdate()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('trend_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Bar Chart (Comparison)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Sort by value for easy reading
df_sorted = df.sort_values('metric', ascending=True)

bars = ax.barh(df_sorted['category'], df_sorted['metric'], color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[0])

# Add value labels
for bar in bars:
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax.text(width + 0.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f'{width:,.0f}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=10)

ax.set_title('Metric by Category (Ranked)', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Metric Value')
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('bar_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Histogram (Distribution)

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

ax.hist(df['value'], bins=30, color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[0], edgecolor='white', alpha=0.8)

# Add mean and median lines
mean_val = df['value'].mean()
median_val = df['value'].median()
ax.axvline(mean_val, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'Mean: {mean_val:,.1f}')
ax.axvline(median_val, color='green', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=f'Median: {median_val:,.1f}')

ax.set_title('Distribution of Values', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Value')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax.legend()
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('histogram.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Heatmap

```python
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))

# Pivot data for heatmap format
pivot = df.pivot_table(index='row_dim', columns='col_dim', values='metric', aggfunc='sum')

sns.heatmap(pivot, annot=True, fmt=',.0f', cmap='YlOrRd',
            linewidths=0.5, ax=ax, cbar_kws={'label': 'Metric Value'})

ax.set_title('Metric by Row Dimension and Column Dimension', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Column Dimension')
ax.set_ylabel('Row Dimension')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('heatmap.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Small Multiples

```python
categories = df['category'].unique()
n_cats = len(categories)
n_cols = min(3, n_cats)
n_rows = (n_cats + n_cols - 1) // n_cols

fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_cols, figsize=(5*n_cols, 4*n_rows), sharex=True, sharey=True)
axes = axes.flatten() if n_cats > 1 else [axes]

for i, cat in enumerate(categories):
    ax = axes[i]
    subset = df[df['category'] == cat]
    ax.plot(subset['date'], subset['value'], color=PALETTE_CATEGORICAL[i % len(PALETTE_CATEGORICAL)])
    ax.set_title(cat, fontsize=12)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Hide empty subplots
for j in range(i+1, len(axes)):
    axes[j].set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle('Trends by Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('small_multiples.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
```

### Number Formatting Helpers

```python
def format_number(val, format_type='number'):
    """Format numbers for chart labels."""
    if format_type == 'currency':
        if abs(val) >= 1e9:
            return f'${val/1e9:.1f}B'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e6:
            return f'${val/1e6:.1f}M'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e3:
            return f'${val/1e3:.1f}K'
        else:
            return f'${val:,.0f}'
    elif format_type == 'percent':
        return f'{val:.1f}%'
    elif format_type == 'number':
        if abs(val) >= 1e9:
            return f'{val/1e9:.1f}B'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e6:
            return f'{val/1e6:.1f}M'
        elif abs(val) >= 1e3:
            return f'{val/1e3:.1f}K'
        else:
            return f'{val:,.0f}'
    return str(val)

# Usage with axis formatter
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: format_number(x, 'currency')))
```

### Interactive Charts with Plotly

```python
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Simple interactive line chart
fig = px.line(df, x='date', y='value', color='category',
              title='Interactive Metric Trend',
              labels={'value': 'Metric Value', 'date': 'Date'})
fig.update_layout(hovermode='x unified')
fig.write_html('interactive_chart.html')
fig.show()

# Interactive scatter with hover data
fig = px.scatter(df, x='metric_a', y='metric_b', color='category',
                 size='size_metric', hover_data=['name', 'detail_field'],
                 title='Correlation Analysis')
fig.show()
```

## Design Principles

### Color

- **Use color purposefully**: Color should encode data, not decorate
- **Highlight the story**: Use a bright accent color for the key insight; grey everything else
- **Sequential data**: Use a single-hue gradient (light to dark) for ordered values
- **Diverging data**: Use a two-hue gradient with neutral midpoint for data with a meaningful center
- **Categorical data**: Use distinct hues, maximum 6-8 before it gets confusing
- **Avoid red/green only**: 8% of men are red-green colorblind. Use blue/orange as primary pair

### Typography

- **Title states the insight**: "Revenue grew 23% YoY" beats "Revenue by Month"
- **Subtitle adds context**: Date range, filters applied, data source
- **Axis labels are readable**: Never rotated 90 degrees if avoidable. Shorten or wrap instead
- **Data labels add precision**: Use on key points, not every single bar
- **Annotation highlights**: Call out specific points with text annotations

### Layout

- **Reduce chart junk**: Remove gridlines, borders, backgrounds that don't carry information
- **Sort meaningfully**: Categories sorted by value (not alphabetically) unless there's a natural order (months, stages)
- **Appropriate aspect ratio**: Time series wider than tall (3:1 to 2:1); comparisons can be squarer
- **White space is good**: Don't cram charts together. Give each visualization room to breathe

### Accuracy

- **Bar charts start at zero**: Always. A bar from 95 to 100 exaggerates a 5% difference
- **Line charts can have non-zero baselines**: When the range of variation is meaningful
- **Consistent scales across panels**: When comparing multiple charts, use the same axis range
- **Show uncertainty**: Error bars, confidence intervals, or ranges when data is uncertain
- **Label your axes**: Never make the reader guess what the numbers mean

## Accessibility Considerations

### Color Blindness

- Never rely on color alone to distinguish data series
- Add pattern fills, different line styles (solid, dashed, dotted), or direct labels
- Test with a colorblind simulator (e.g., Coblis, Sim Daltonism)
- Use the colorblind-friendly palette: `sns.color_palette("colorblind")`

### Screen Readers

- Include alt text describing the chart's key finding
- Provide a data table alternative alongside the visualization
- Use semantic titles and labels

### General Accessibility

- Sufficient contrast between data elements and background
- Text size minimum 10pt for labels, 12pt for titles
- Avoid conveying information only through spatial position (add labels)
- Consider printing: does the chart work in black and white?

### Accessibility Checklist

Before sharing a visualization:
- [ ] Chart works without color (patterns, labels, or line styles differentiate series)
- [ ] Text is readable at standard zoom level
- [ ] Title describes the insight, not just the data
- [ ] Axes are labeled with units
- [ ] Legend is clear and positioned without obscuring data
- [ ] Data source and date range are noted

# Kubernetes Multi-Environment Deployment Pipeline

## Overview
This dataset describes a Kubernetes deployment pipeline spanning four environments (dev, staging, canary, production) with automated rollback mechanisms, blue-green traffic switching at the production stage, and HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) scaling decision points at every environment.

## Data Source

### pipeline_nodes
34 nodes representing pipeline steps. Fields: `id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (string, human-readable name), `lane` (string: dev | staging | canary | production | global), `type` (string: action | check | decision | hpa_decision | hpa_action | rollback | terminal), `order` (integer, sequencing hint). Some nodes carry additional threshold fields such as `cpu_threshold_pct`, `mem_threshold_pct`, `error_rate_threshold_pct`, `p99_latency_ms_threshold`, `traffic_pct`, and `duration_min`.

### pipeline_edges
48 directed edges. Fields: `from` and `to` (node id references), `type` (string: forward | rollback | hpa_branch | blue_green), `label` (string, condition or annotation on the edge).

### hpa_policies
4 rows, one per environment. Fields: `environment`, `min_replicas`, `max_replicas`, `cpu_target_pct`, `mem_target_pct`, `scale_up_cooldown_sec`, `scale_down_cooldown_sec`. Replica counts are integers; thresholds are percentages.

### environment_config
4 rows. Fields: `environment`, `namespace`, `gate_error_rate_pct` (float), `gate_p99_latency_ms` (integer or null), `traffic_strategy` (string: direct | weighted_canary | blue_green), `rollback_auto` (boolean), `approval_required` (boolean).

## Data Notes
- Threshold values tighten progressively from dev to production (e.g., error-rate gate: 5% → 2% → 1% → 0.5%).
- The canary stage uses three progressive traffic ramp steps (10% → 25% → 50%) before the production gate.
- Blue-green switching applies only to the production environment; other environments use direct or weighted-canary strategies.
- HPA scale-up and scale-down nodes are shared (global lane) and referenced from each environment's HPA check.

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.2, style='->', label='', curved=False):
    arrowprops = dict(
        arrowstyle=style,
        color=color,
        lw=lw,
        connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.0' if not curved else 'arc3,rad=0.3',
    )
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2,y2), xytext=(x1,y1),
                arrowprops=arrowprops, zorder=2)
    if label:
        mx, my = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.07, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=4.8, color=color, zorder=5,
                bbox=dict(facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7, pad=1))

            tx = np.sign(dx) * NODE_NW
            ty = np.sign(dy) * NODE_NH
            return (cx + tx, cy + ty)
        if abs(dx) > abs(dy):
            return (cx + np.sign(dx)*NODE_NW, cy)
        else:
            return (cx, cy + np.sign(dy)*NODE_NH)

    cx, cy = pos

    color = NODE_COLORS.get(ntype, '#6B7280')

        ax.add_patch(diamond)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.2,
                color=NODE_TEXT, fontweight='bold', zorder=4,

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.2, style='->', label='', curved=False):
    arrowprops = dict(
        arrowstyle=style,
        color=color,
        lw=lw,
        connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.0' if not curved else 'arc3,rad=0.3',
    )
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2,y2), xytext=(x1,y1),
                arrowprops=arrowprops, zorder=2)
    if label:
        mx, my = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.07, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=4.8, color=color, zorder=5,
                bbox=dict(facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.7, pad=1))

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 34, 20
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

# ── Swimlane geometry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LEFT_PAD = 1.45        # label column
RIGHT_PAD = 0.3
TOP_TITLE = 0.90       # title area height
LANE_NAMES = ['dev', 'staging', 'canary', 'production']
N_LANES = 4
# Each lane: main row + rollback row
LANE_MAIN_H  = 1.80   # height for main nodes
LANE_RB_H    = 0.95   # height for rollback node row
LANE_H = LANE_MAIN_H + LANE_RB_H
TOTAL_LANE_H = N_LANES * LANE_H
CHART_TOP = FIG_H - TOP_TITLE

# y-centre of main row and rollback row per lane (top to bottom: dev, staging, canary, prod)
def lane_top(i):   return CHART_TOP - i * LANE_H
def lane_main_y(i):  return lane_top(i) - LANE_MAIN_H * 0.45
def lane_rb_y(i):    return lane_top(i) - LANE_MAIN_H - LANE_RB_H * 0.52

LANE_BG = {
    'dev':        '#EFF6FF',
    'staging':    '#F0FDF4',
    'canary':     '#FFFBEB',
    'production': '#FFF1F2',
}
LANE_BORDER = {
    'dev':        '#BFDBFE',
    'staging':    '#BBF7D0',
    'canary':     '#FDE68A',
    'production': '#FECDD3',
}
LANE_LABEL_COLOR = {
    'dev':        '#1E40AF',
    'staging':    '#166534',
    'canary':     '#92400E',
    'production': '#9F1239',
}

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    'action':      '#2563EB',
    'check':       '#059669',
    'decision':    '#D97706',
    'hpa_dec':     '#7C3AED',
    'hpa_act':     '#6D28D9',
    'rollback':    '#DC2626',
    'terminal':    '#15803D',
    'bg_action':   '#1D4ED8',   # blue-green step highlight
}
EC = {
    'forward':    '#374151',
    'rollback':   '#B91C1C',
    'hpa':        '#7C3AED',
    'blue_green': '#1D4ED8',
}

NODE_W = 1.68
NODE_H = 0.56
DIA_W  = 0.78   # diamond half-width

# ── Draw swimlane bands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for i, name in enumerate(LANE_NAMES):
    yb = lane_top(i) - LANE_H
    rect = plt.Rectangle((0, yb), FIG_W, LANE_H,
                          facecolor=LANE_BG[name], edgecolor=LANE_BORDER[name],
                          linewidth=1.8, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    lbl = {'dev':'DEV\napp-dev','staging':'STAGING\napp-staging',
           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[name]
    ax.text(0.72, lane_main_y(i), lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_LABEL_COLOR[name], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BORDER[name],
                      edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

# ── Column x positions (22 columns across usable width) ──────────────────────
N_COLS = 22
def cx(col):
    usable = FIG_W - LEFT_PAD - RIGHT_PAD
    return LEFT_PAD + (col + 0.5) * usable / N_COLS

# ── Node map: id → (x, y, type, label) ───────────────────────────────────────
MY = [lane_main_y(i) for i in range(4)]   # main y per lane
RY = [lane_rb_y(i)  for i in range(4)]    # rollback y per lane

# HPA global zone: between dev rollback and staging main
HPA_Y = (RY[0] + MY[1]) / 2

NP = {
    # DEV (lane 0)
    'src-commit':    (cx(0),  MY[0], 'action',   'Source Commit\n& PR Merge'),
    'ci-build':      (cx(1),  MY[0], 'action',   'CI Build &\nUnit Tests'),
    'docker-push':   (cx(2),  MY[0], 'action',   'Docker Image\nBuild & Push'),

    'staging-perf':        (cx(9),  MY[1], 'check',    'Performance/\nLoad Tests'),
    'staging-gate':        (cx(10), MY[1], 'decision', 'Staging Health Gate\nerr < 2%'),
    'rollback-staging':    (cx(10), RY[1], 'rollback', 'Rollback Staging\nDeployment'),

    # CANARY (lane 2)
    'canary-deploy':    (cx(10), MY[2], 'action',   'Canary Deploy\n10% Traffic'),
    'canary-observe':   (cx(11), MY[2], 'check',    'Observe Metrics\n5 min'),
    'canary-hpa-check': (cx(12), MY[2], 'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>50%|Mem>60%'),
    'canary-ramp-25':   (cx(13), MY[2], 'action',   'Ramp Canary\n25% Traffic'),
    'canary-observe-2': (cx(14), MY[2], 'check',    'Observe Metrics\n10 min'),
    'canary-ramp-50':   (cx(15), MY[2], 'action',   'Ramp Canary\n50% Traffic'),
    'canary-gate':      (cx(16), MY[2], 'decision', 'Canary Gate\nerr<1%|p99<250ms'),
    'rollback-canary':  (cx(14), RY[2], 'rollback', 'Rollback Canary\n→Stable Traffic'),

    # PRODUCTION (lane 3)
    'prod-prep':     (cx(16), MY[3], 'bg_action', 'Prepare\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-deploy-g': (cx(17), MY[3], 'bg_action', 'Deploy to\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-hc-green': (cx(18), MY[3], 'check',     'Green Slot\nHealth Check'),
    'prod-hpa':      (cx(19), MY[3], 'hpa_dec',   'HPA Check\nCPU>45%|Mem>55%'),
    'prod-bg-gate':  (cx(20), MY[3], 'decision',  'Blue-Green\nSwitch Gate\nerr<0.5%|p99<200ms'),
    'prod-switch':   (cx(21), MY[3], 'bg_action', 'Switch 100%\nTraffic → Green'),
    'prod-verify':   (cx(21), MY[3]-0.72, 'check', 'Post-Switch\nVerify 3min'),
    'prod-finalize': (cx(20), MY[3]-0.72, 'action','Decommission\nBlue Slot'),
    'prod-complete': (cx(19), MY[3]-0.72, 'terminal','Pipeline\nComplete ✓'),
    'rollback-prod': (cx(20), RY[3], 'rollback', 'Rollback: Revert\nTraffic → Blue'),

    # GLOBAL (HPA actions + alert)
    'hpa-up':     (cx(5),  HPA_Y, 'hpa_act', 'HPA: Scale Up\nReplicas'),
    'hpa-down':   (cx(6.8),HPA_Y, 'hpa_act', 'HPA: Scale Down\nReplicas'),
    'alert':      (cx(9),  HPA_Y, 'action',  'Alert On-Call\n& Open Incident'),
}

# HPA global zone background
hpa_zone_y = HPA_Y - 0.45
hpa_zone_h = 0.90
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((LEFT_PAD, hpa_zone_y), FIG_W-LEFT_PAD-RIGHT_PAD, hpa_zone_h,
    facecolor='#EDE9FE', edgecolor='#C4B5FD', linewidth=1.2,
    linestyle='--', zorder=0.5, alpha=0.7))
ax.text(LEFT_PAD+0.1, HPA_Y, 'HPA / GLOBAL', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, color='#5B21B6', style='italic', fontweight='bold', zorder=1)

# ── Draw node helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def node_color(ntype):
    return {'action': C['action'], 'check': C['check'], 'decision': C['decision'],
            'hpa_dec': C['hpa_dec'], 'hpa_act': C['hpa_act'],
            'rollback': C['rollback'], 'terminal': C['terminal'],
            'bg_action': C['bg_action']}.get(ntype, '#6B7280')

def draw_node(nid):
    x, y, ntype, label = NP[nid]
    col = node_color(ntype)
    if ntype == 'decision':
        pts = np.array([[x, y+DIA_W*0.7],[x+DIA_W*1.15,y],[x,y-DIA_W*0.7],[x-DIA_W*1.15,y]])
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon(pts, facecolor=col, edgecolor='white', lw=1.8, zorder=3))
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.8,
                color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4, multialignment='center')
    else:
        bx = FancyBboxPatch((x-NODE_W/2, y-NODE_H/2), NODE_W, NODE_H,
                             boxstyle='round,pad=0.06', facecolor=col,
                             edgecolor='white' if ntype not in ('rollback','terminal') else ('#7F1D1D' if ntype=='rollback' else '#14532D'),
                             linewidth=1.8 if ntype in ('rollback','terminal') else 1.2, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(bx)
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.2,
                color='white', zorder=4, multialignment='center',
                fontweight='bold' if ntype in ('rollback','terminal','decision') else 'normal')

def node_bound(nid, dx, dy):
    """Return edge point of node in direction (dx,dy)."""
    x, y, ntype, _ = NP[nid]
    if ntype == 'decision':
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy):
            return (x + np.sign(dx)*DIA_W*1.15, y)
        else:
            return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*DIA_W*0.7)
    else:
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy):
            return (x + np.sign(dx)*NODE_W/2, y)
        else:
            return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*NODE_H/2)

# ── Arrow helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def arr(fr, to, etype, lbl='', rad=0.0, color=None):
    if fr not in NP or to not in NP:
        return
    x1, y1 = NP[fr][:2]; x2, y2 = NP[to][:2]
    dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
    if dx==0 and dy==0:
        return
    ec = color or EC.get(etype, '#374151')
    lw = 1.8 if etype in ('rollback','blue_green') else 1.3
    s1 = node_bound(fr, dx, dy)
    s2 = node_bound(to, -dx, -dy)
    conn = f'arc3,rad={rad:.2f}'
    ax.annotate('', xy=s2, xytext=s1, zorder=2,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ec, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=conn))
    if lbl:
        mx, my = (s1[0]+s2[0])/2, (s1[1]+s2[1])/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.05, lbl, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=4.8, color=ec, zorder=5,
                bbox=dict(facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.75, pad=0.8))

# ── Edges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

arr('src-commit',    'ci-build',       'forward')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 34, 20
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

# ── Swimlane geometry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LEFT_PAD = 1.45        # label column
RIGHT_PAD = 0.3
TOP_TITLE = 0.90       # title area height
LANE_NAMES = ['dev', 'staging', 'canary', 'production']
N_LANES = 4
# Each lane: main row + rollback row
LANE_MAIN_H  = 1.80   # height for main nodes
LANE_RB_H    = 0.95   # height for rollback node row
LANE_H = LANE_MAIN_H + LANE_RB_H
TOTAL_LANE_H = N_LANES * LANE_H
CHART_TOP = FIG_H - TOP_TITLE

# y-centre of main row and rollback row per lane (top to bottom: dev, staging, canary, prod)
def lane_top(i):   return CHART_TOP - i * LANE_H
def lane_main_y(i):  return lane_top(i) - LANE_MAIN_H * 0.45
def lane_rb_y(i):    return lane_top(i) - LANE_MAIN_H - LANE_RB_H * 0.52

LANE_BG = {
    'dev':        '#EFF6FF',
    'staging':    '#F0FDF4',
    'canary':     '#FFFBEB',
    'production': '#FFF1F2',
}
LANE_BORDER = {
    'dev':        '#BFDBFE',
    'staging':    '#BBF7D0',
    'canary':     '#FDE68A',
    'production': '#FECDD3',
}
LANE_LABEL_COLOR = {
    'dev':        '#1E40AF',
    'staging':    '#166534',
    'canary':     '#92400E',
    'production': '#9F1239',
}

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    'action':      '#2563EB',
    'check':       '#059669',
    'decision':    '#D97706',
    'hpa_dec':     '#7C3AED',
    'hpa_act':     '#6D28D9',
    'rollback':    '#DC2626',
    'terminal':    '#15803D',
    'bg_action':   '#1D4ED8',   # blue-green step highlight
}
EC = {
    'forward':    '#374151',
    'rollback':   '#B91C1C',
    'hpa':        '#7C3AED',
    'blue_green': '#1D4ED8',
}

NODE_W = 1.68
NODE_H = 0.56
DIA_W  = 0.78   # diamond half-width

# ── Draw swimlane bands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for i, name in enumerate(LANE_NAMES):
    yb = lane_top(i) - LANE_H
    rect = plt.Rectangle((0, yb), FIG_W, LANE_H,
                          facecolor=LANE_BG[name], edgecolor=LANE_BORDER[name],
                          linewidth=1.8, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    lbl = {'dev':'DEV\napp-dev','staging':'STAGING\napp-staging',
           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[name]
    ax.text(0.72, lane_main_y(i), lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_LABEL_COLOR[name], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BORDER[name],
                      edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

# ── Column x positions (22 columns across usable width) ──────────────────────
N_COLS = 22
def cx(col):
    usable = FIG_W - LEFT_PAD - RIGHT_PAD
    return LEFT_PAD + (col + 0.5) * usable / N_COLS

# ── Node map: id → (x, y, type, label) ───────────────────────────────────────
MY = [lane_main_y(i) for i in range(4)]   # main y per lane
RY = [lane_rb_y(i)  for i in range(4)]    # rollback y per lane

# HPA global zone: between dev rollback and staging main
HPA_Y = (RY[0] + MY[1]) / 2

NP = {

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 34, 20
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

# ── Swimlane geometry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LEFT_PAD = 1.45        # label column
RIGHT_PAD = 0.3
TOP_TITLE = 0.90       # title area height
LANE_NAMES = ['dev', 'staging', 'canary', 'production']
N_LANES = 4
# Each lane: main row + rollback row
LANE_MAIN_H  = 1.80   # height for main nodes
LANE_RB_H    = 0.95   # height for rollback node row
LANE_H = LANE_MAIN_H + LANE_RB_H
TOTAL_LANE_H = N_LANES * LANE_H
CHART_TOP = FIG_H - TOP_TITLE

def lane_top(i):   return CHART_TOP - i * LANE_H
def lane_main_y(i):  return lane_top(i) - LANE_MAIN_H * 0.45

    'staging':    '#BBF7D0',
    'canary':     '#FDE68A',
    'production': '#FECDD3',
}
LANE_LABEL_COLOR = {
    'dev':        '#1E40AF',
    'staging':    '#166534',
    'canary':     '#92400E',
    'production': '#9F1239',
}

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    'action':      '#2563EB',
    'check':       '#059669',
    'decision':    '#D97706',
    'hpa_dec':     '#7C3AED',
    'hpa_act':     '#6D28D9',
    'rollback':    '#DC2626',
    'terminal':    '#15803D',

}
EC = {
    'forward':    '#374151',
    'rollback':   '#B91C1C',
    'hpa':        '#7C3AED',
    'blue_green': '#1D4ED8',

NODE_W = 1.68
NODE_H = 0.56
DIA_W  = 0.78   # diamond half-width

# ── Draw swimlane bands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for i, name in enumerate(LANE_NAMES):
    yb = lane_top(i) - LANE_H
    rect = plt.Rectangle((0, yb), FIG_W, LANE_H,
                          facecolor=LANE_BG[name], edgecolor=LANE_BORDER[name],
                          linewidth=1.8, zorder=0)

           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[name]
    ax.text(0.72, lane_main_y(i), lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_LABEL_COLOR[name], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BORDER[name],
                      edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

# ── Column x positions (22 columns across usable width) ──────────────────────
N_COLS = 22
def cx(col):
    usable = FIG_W - LEFT_PAD - RIGHT_PAD
    return LEFT_PAD + (col + 0.5) * usable / N_COLS

# ── Node map: id → (x, y, type, label) ───────────────────────────────────────
MY = [lane_main_y(i) for i in range(4)]   # main y per lane
RY = [lane_rb_y(i)  for i in range(4)]    # rollback y per lane

# HPA global zone: between dev rollback and staging main
HPA_Y = (RY[0] + MY[1]) / 2

NP = {
    # DEV (lane 0)
    'src-commit':    (cx(0),  MY[0], 'action',   'Source Commit\n& PR Merge'),
    'ci-build':      (cx(1),  MY[0], 'action',   'CI Build &\nUnit Tests'),
    'docker-push':   (cx(2),  MY[0], 'action',   'Docker Image\nBuild & Push'),
    'dev-deploy':    (cx(3),  MY[0], 'action',   'Deploy to Dev\nNamespace'),
    'dev-smoke':     (cx(4),  MY[0], 'check',    'Smoke Tests\n(Dev)'),
    'dev-hpa-check': (cx(5),  MY[0], 'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>60%|Mem>70%'),
    'dev-gate':      (cx(6),  MY[0], 'decision', 'Dev Health Gate\nerr < 5%'),
    'rollback-dev':  (cx(6),  RY[0], 'rollback', 'Rollback Dev\nDeployment'),

    # STAGING (lane 1)
    'staging-deploy':      (cx(6),  MY[1], 'action',   'Deploy to Staging\nNamespace'),
    'staging-integration': (cx(7),  MY[1], 'check',    'Integration &\nE2E Tests'),
    'staging-hpa-check':   (cx(8),  MY[1], 'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>55%|Mem>65%'),
    'staging-perf':        (cx(9),  MY[1], 'check',    'Performance/\nLoad Tests'),
    'staging-gate':        (cx(10), MY[1], 'decision', 'Staging Health Gate\nerr < 2%'),
    'rollback-staging':    (cx(10), RY[1], 'rollback', 'Rollback Staging\nDeployment'),

    # CANARY (lane 2)
    'canary-deploy':    (cx(10), MY[2], 'action',   'Canary Deploy\n10% Traffic'),
    'canary-observe':   (cx(11), MY[2], 'check',    'Observe Metrics\n5 min'),
    'canary-hpa-check': (cx(12), MY[2], 'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>50%|Mem>60%'),
    'canary-ramp-25':   (cx(13), MY[2], 'action',   'Ramp Canary\n25% Traffic'),
    'canary-observe-2': (cx(14), MY[2], 'check',    'Observe Metrics\n10 min'),
    'canary-ramp-50':   (cx(15), MY[2], 'action',   'Ramp Canary\n50% Traffic'),
    'canary-gate':      (cx(16), MY[2], 'decision', 'Canary Gate\nerr<1%|p99<250ms'),
    'rollback-canary':  (cx(14), RY[2], 'rollback', 'Rollback Canary\n→Stable Traffic'),

    # PRODUCTION (lane 3)
    'prod-prep':     (cx(16), MY[3], 'bg_action', 'Prepare\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-deploy-g': (cx(17), MY[3], 'bg_action', 'Deploy to\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-hc-green': (cx(18), MY[3], 'check',     'Green Slot\nHealth Check'),
    'prod-hpa':      (cx(19), MY[3], 'hpa_dec',   'HPA Check\nCPU>45%|Mem>55%'),
    'prod-bg-gate':  (cx(20), MY[3], 'decision',  'Blue-Green\nSwitch Gate\nerr<0.5%|p99<200ms'),
    'prod-switch':   (cx(21), MY[3], 'bg_action', 'Switch 100%\nTraffic → Green'),
    'prod-verify':   (cx(21), MY[3]-0.72, 'check', 'Post-Switch\nVerify 3min'),
    'prod-finalize': (cx(20), MY[3]-0.72, 'action','Decommission\nBlue Slot'),
    'prod-complete': (cx(19), MY[3]-0.72, 'terminal','Pipeline\nComplete ✓'),
    'rollback-prod': (cx(20), RY[3], 'rollback', 'Rollback: Revert\nTraffic → Blue'),

    # GLOBAL (HPA actions + alert)
    'hpa-up':     (cx(5),  HPA_Y, 'hpa_act', 'HPA: Scale Up\nReplicas'),

# HPA global zone background
hpa_zone_y = HPA_Y - 0.45
hpa_zone_h = 0.90
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((LEFT_PAD, hpa_zone_y), FIG_W-LEFT_PAD-RIGHT_PAD, hpa_zone_h,

# ── Draw node helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def node_color(ntype):
    return {'action': C['action'], 'check': C['check'], 'decision': C['decision'],
            'hpa_dec': C['hpa_dec'], 'hpa_act': C['hpa_act'],
            'rollback': C['rollback'], 'terminal': C['terminal'],
            'bg_action': C['bg_action']}.get(ntype, '#6B7280')

def draw_node(nid):
    x, y, ntype, label = NP[nid]
    col = node_color(ntype)
    if ntype == 'decision':
        pts = np.array([[x, y+DIA_W*0.7],[x+DIA_W*1.15,y],[x,y-DIA_W*0.7],[x-DIA_W*1.15,y]])
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon(pts, facecolor=col, edgecolor='white', lw=1.8, zorder=3))
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.8,
                color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4, multialignment='center')
    else:
        bx = FancyBboxPatch((x-NODE_W/2, y-NODE_H/2), NODE_W, NODE_H,
                             boxstyle='round,pad=0.06', facecolor=col,
                             edgecolor='white' if ntype not in ('rollback','terminal') else ('#7F1D1D' if ntype=='rollback' else '#14532D'),
                             linewidth=1.8 if ntype in ('rollback','terminal') else 1.2, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(bx)
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.2,
                color='white', zorder=4, multialignment='center',
                fontweight='bold' if ntype in ('rollback','terminal','decision') else 'normal')

def node_bound(nid, dx, dy):
    """Return edge point of node in direction (dx,dy)."""
    x, y, ntype, _ = NP[nid]
    if ntype == 'decision':
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy):
            return (x + np.sign(dx)*DIA_W*1.15, y)
        else:
            return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*DIA_W*0.7)
    else:
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy):
            return (x + np.sign(dx)*NODE_W/2, y)
        else:
            return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*NODE_H/2)

# ── Arrow helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def arr(fr, to, etype, lbl='', rad=0.0, color=None):
    if fr not in NP or to not in NP:
        return
    x1, y1 = NP[fr][:2]; x2, y2 = NP[to][:2]
    dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
    if dx==0 and dy==0:
        return
    ec = color or EC.get(etype, '#374151')
    lw = 1.8 if etype in ('rollback','blue_green') else 1.3
    s1 = node_bound(fr, dx, dy)
    s2 = node_bound(to, -dx, -dy)
    conn = f'arc3,rad={rad:.2f}'
    ax.annotate('', xy=s2, xytext=s1, zorder=2,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ec, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=conn))
    if lbl:
        mx, my = (s1[0]+s2[0])/2, (s1[1]+s2[1])/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.05, lbl, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=4.8, color=ec, zorder=5,
                bbox=dict(facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.75, pad=0.8))

# ── Edges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DEV forward flow
arr('src-commit',    'ci-build',       'forward')
arr('ci-build',      'docker-push',    'forward', 'tests pass')
arr('docker-push',   'dev-deploy',     'forward')
arr('dev-deploy',    'dev-smoke',      'forward')
arr('dev-smoke',     'dev-hpa-check',  'forward', 'pass')
arr('dev-hpa-check', 'dev-gate',       'forward', 'in range')
arr('dev-gate',      'staging-deploy', 'forward', 'err < 5%')
# Dev rollback
arr('dev-gate',      'rollback-dev',   'rollback', 'err ≥ 5%', rad=-0.25)
arr('rollback-dev',  'alert',          'rollback', '', rad=0.2)
# HPA branches from dev
arr('dev-hpa-check', 'hpa-up',   'hpa', 'CPU>60%', rad=0.25)
arr('dev-hpa-check', 'hpa-down', 'hpa', 'CPU<25%', rad=0.3)
arr('hpa-up',   'dev-gate', 'hpa', 'scaled', rad=0.2)
arr('hpa-down', 'dev-gate', 'hpa', 'scaled', rad=-0.2)

# STAGING forward flow
arr('staging-deploy',      'staging-integration', 'forward')
arr('staging-integration', 'staging-hpa-check',   'forward', 'pass')
arr('staging-hpa-check',   'staging-perf',         'forward', 'in range')
arr('staging-perf',        'staging-gate',         'forward', 'pass')
arr('staging-gate',        'canary-deploy',         'forward', 'err < 2%')
# Staging rollback
arr('staging-gate',        'rollback-staging', 'rollback', 'err ≥ 2%', rad=-0.25)
arr('staging-integration', 'rollback-staging', 'rollback', 'fail',    rad=0.3)
arr('rollback-staging',    'alert',             'rollback', '', rad=0.15)
# HPA branches from staging
arr('staging-hpa-check', 'hpa-up',   'hpa', 'CPU>55%', rad=0.2)
arr('staging-hpa-check', 'hpa-down', 'hpa', 'CPU<20%', rad=0.25)

# CANARY forward flow
arr('canary-deploy',    'canary-observe',   'forward')
arr('canary-observe',   'canary-hpa-check', 'forward', 'ok')
arr('canary-hpa-check', 'canary-ramp-25',   'forward', 'in range')
arr('canary-ramp-25',   'canary-observe-2', 'forward')
arr('canary-observe-2', 'canary-ramp-50',   'forward', 'ok')
arr('canary-ramp-50',   'canary-gate',      'forward')
arr('canary-gate',      'prod-prep',         'forward', 'err<1%|p99<250ms')
# Canary rollback
arr('canary-gate',      'rollback-canary', 'rollback', 'err≥1%',  rad=-0.25)
arr('canary-observe',   'rollback-canary', 'rollback', 'degraded', rad=0.3)
arr('canary-observe-2', 'rollback-canary', 'rollback', 'degraded', rad=0.3)
arr('rollback-canary',  'alert',            'rollback', '', rad=0.2)
# HPA branches from canary
arr('canary-hpa-check', 'hpa-up',   'hpa', 'CPU>50%', rad=0.15)
arr('canary-hpa-check', 'hpa-down', 'hpa', 'CPU<20%', rad=0.2)

# PRODUCTION blue-green flow
arr('prod-prep',     'prod-deploy-g', 'blue_green')
arr('prod-deploy-g', 'prod-hc-green', 'blue_green')
arr('prod-hc-green', 'prod-hpa',      'forward', 'healthy')
arr('prod-hpa',      'prod-bg-gate',  'forward', 'in range')
arr('prod-bg-gate',  'prod-switch',   'blue_green', 'err<0.5%\np99<200ms')
arr('prod-switch',   'prod-verify',   'blue_green')
arr('prod-verify',   'prod-finalize', 'forward', 'verified OK')
arr('prod-finalize', 'prod-complete', 'forward')

arr('prod-bg-gate',  'rollback-prod', 'rollback', 'err≥0.5%', rad=-0.25)
arr('prod-hc-green', 'rollback-prod', 'rollback', 'unhealthy', rad=0.3)
arr('prod-verify',   'rollback-prod', 'rollback', 'failed',    rad=0.25)

arr('prod-hpa', 'hpa-up',   'hpa', 'CPU>45%', rad=0.2)
arr('prod-hpa', 'hpa-down', 'hpa', 'CPU<15%', rad=0.25)

    draw_node(nid)

bg_x2 = NP['prod-switch'][0]  + NODE_W/2 + 0.1
bg_yt = MY[3] + NODE_H/2 + 0.16

# ── HPA thresholds side-table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

hdr = ['Env','Replicas','CPU ↑','Mem ↑','Cooldown ↑/↓']
cw  = [0, 0.96, 1.72, 2.42, 3.10]
for j,h in enumerate(hdr):
    ax.text(tx+cw[j], ty-0.36, h, ha='left', va='top', fontsize=6.2,

rows = [('Dev','1–5','60%','70%','30s / 60s'),
        ('Staging','2–10','55%','65%','45s / 90s'),
        ('Canary','2–15','50%','60%','30s / 120s'),

for i,row in enumerate(rows):
    for j,val in enumerate(row):
        ax.text(tx+cw[j], ty-0.60-i*0.26, val, ha='left', va='top',
                fontsize=6, color='#1E293B', zorder=6)

# ── Title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.text(FIG_W/2, FIG_H-0.17,
        'Kubernetes Multi-Environment Deployment Pipeline',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A')
ax.text(FIG_W/2, FIG_H-0.55,
        'Swimlane layout  ·  Forward deployment flow  ·  Automatic rollback paths  ·  HPA scaling checkpoints  ·  Blue-green production switch',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.8, color='#475569')

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_items = [
    ('Action / Step',         C['action'],     'rect'),
    ('Test / Check',          C['check'],      'rect'),
    ('Decision / Health Gate',C['decision'],   'dia'),
    ('HPA Decision Point',    C['hpa_dec'],    'rect'),
    ('HPA Scale Action',      C['hpa_act'],    'rect'),
    ('Rollback Step',         C['rollback'],   'rect'),
    ('Pipeline Terminal',     C['terminal'],   'rect'),
    ('Blue-Green Step',       C['bg_action'],  'rect'),
    ('Forward Flow',          EC['forward'],   'arr'),
    ('Rollback Path',         EC['rollback'],  'arr'),
    ('HPA Branch',            EC['hpa'],       'arr'),
    ('Blue-Green Switch',     EC['blue_green'],'arr'),
]
lx, ly = LEFT_PAD, 0.12
lw_box, lh_box = FIG_W - LEFT_PAD - RIGHT_PAD, 0.85
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((lx-0.15, ly-0.06), lw_box+0.25, lh_box,
             boxstyle='round,pad=0.04', facecolor='white',

ax.text(lx + lw_box/2, ly + lh_box - 0.1, 'Legend',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#0F172A', zorder=7)

    if shape == 'arr':
        ax.annotate('', xy=(ix+0.30, iy), xytext=(ix+0.04, iy), zorder=7,

    elif shape == 'dia':
        d = 0.12
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon([[ix+0.17,iy+d],[ix+0.32,iy],[ix+0.17,iy-d],[ix+0.02,iy]],
                     facecolor=color, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1, zorder=7))

                     boxstyle='round,pad=0.03', facecolor=color,
                     edgecolor='white', linewidth=1, zorder=7))
    ax.text(ix+0.38, iy, label, ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=6.5, color='#1E293B', zorder=7)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 1])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
print("Saved.")

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 36, 22
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W); ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

# ── Geometry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LEFT   = 1.50        # label strip width
RIGHT  = 0.20
TITLE_H= 0.72
USABLE_W = FIG_W - LEFT - RIGHT

# 4 lanes occupy the area below title, each split: main row + sub row
LANE_MAIN = 2.00     # main node row height
LANE_SUB  = 1.10     # rollback / secondary row height
LANE_H    = LANE_MAIN + LANE_SUB
# HPA global zone sits between dev sub-row and staging main row
HPA_H = 0.90

# Total height budget
CONTENT_H = 4 * LANE_H + HPA_H
CHART_TOP = FIG_H - TITLE_H   # where lane 0 top starts

# Offsets — build from top
# lane_top[i] = top y of lane i
lane_top = [CHART_TOP - i * LANE_H for i in range(4)]
# Squeeze in HPA zone between dev (lane 0) and staging (lane 1)
# We override: dev sub-row, HPA zone, staging main row are packed tightly
DEV_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
DEV_RB_Y     = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
HPA_ZONE_Y   = (DEV_RB_Y + lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN) / 2   # midpoint
STAG_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
STAG_RB_Y    = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
CAN_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
CAN_RB_Y     = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
PROD_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
PROD_RB_Y    = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52

# Recompute with compact spacing
TITLE_TOP = FIG_H
# Stack: title(0.72), dev-main, dev-rb, hpa-zone, stag-main, stag-rb,

def node_col(nt):
    return {'action':NC['action'],'check':NC['check'],'decision':NC['decision'],
            'hpa_dec':NC['hpa_dec'],'hpa_act':NC['hpa_act'],
            'rollback':NC['rollback'],'terminal':NC['terminal'],

def draw_node(nid):
    x,y,nt,label = NP[nid]
    col = node_col(nt)
    if nt == 'decision':
        # Diamond — wider for multi-line labels
        dw, dh = DW*1.1, DW*0.72
        pts = np.array([[x, y+dh],[x+dw, y],[x, y-dh],[x-dw, y]])
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon(pts, facecolor=col, edgecolor='white', lw=1.8, zorder=3))
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
                color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4, multialignment='center')
    else:
        eb = {'rollback':'#7F1D1D','terminal':'#14532D'}.get(nt,'white')
        elw= 1.8 if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 1.2
        bx = FancyBboxPatch((x-NW/2, y-NH/2), NW, NH,
                             boxstyle='round,pad=0.07', facecolor=col,
                             edgecolor=eb, linewidth=elw, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(bx)
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.0,
                color='white', zorder=4, multialignment='center',
                fontweight='bold' if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 'normal')

def node_pt(nid, dx, dy):
    x,y,nt,_ = NP[nid]
    if nt == 'decision':
        dw, dh = DW*1.1, DW*0.72
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy): return (x + np.sign(dx)*dw, y)
        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*dh)
    else:
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy): return (x + np.sign(dx)*NW/2, y)
        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*NH/2)

# ── Arrows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def arr(fr, to, etype, lbl='', rad=0.0, color=None):
    if fr not in NP or to not in NP: return
    x1,y1=NP[fr][:2]; x2,y2=NP[to][:2]
    dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
    if dx==0 and dy==0: return
    ec = color or EC.get(etype,'#374151')
    lw = 1.9 if etype in ('rollback','blue_green') else 1.3
    s1 = node_pt(fr, dx, dy)
    s2 = node_pt(to,-dx,-dy)
    ax.annotate('', xy=s2, xytext=s1, zorder=2,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ec, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad:.2f}'))
    if lbl:

        ax.text(mx, my+0.06, lbl, ha='center', va='bottom',

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 36, 22
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W); ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

# ── Geometry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LEFT   = 1.50        # label strip width
RIGHT  = 0.20
TITLE_H= 0.72
USABLE_W = FIG_W - LEFT - RIGHT

# 4 lanes occupy the area below title, each split: main row + sub row
LANE_MAIN = 2.00     # main node row height
LANE_SUB  = 1.10     # rollback / secondary row height
LANE_H    = LANE_MAIN + LANE_SUB
# HPA global zone sits between dev sub-row and staging main row
HPA_H = 0.90

# Total height budget
CONTENT_H = 4 * LANE_H + HPA_H
CHART_TOP = FIG_H - TITLE_H   # where lane 0 top starts

# Offsets — build from top
# lane_top[i] = top y of lane i
lane_top = [CHART_TOP - i * LANE_H for i in range(4)]
# Squeeze in HPA zone between dev (lane 0) and staging (lane 1)
# We override: dev sub-row, HPA zone, staging main row are packed tightly
DEV_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
DEV_RB_Y     = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
HPA_ZONE_Y   = (DEV_RB_Y + lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN) / 2   # midpoint
STAG_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
STAG_RB_Y    = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
CAN_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
CAN_RB_Y     = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
PROD_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
PROD_RB_Y    = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52

# Recompute with compact spacing
TITLE_TOP = FIG_H
# Stack: title(0.72), dev-main, dev-rb, hpa-zone, stag-main, stag-rb,
#        can-main, can-rb, prod-main+prod-sub(2 rows), prod-rb
ROW_H = {
    'dev_main':  2.00, 'dev_rb': 0.90,
    'hpa':       0.80,
    'stag_main': 2.00, 'stag_rb': 0.90,
    'can_main':  2.00, 'can_rb': 0.90,
    'prod_main': 1.30, 'prod_sub': 1.00, 'prod_rb': 0.90,
}
total_h = TITLE_H + sum(ROW_H.values())  # ~14.5

# Place rows
y = FIG_H - TITLE_H
def alloc(h):
    global y
    cy = y - h / 2
    y -= h

            'rollback':NC['rollback'],'terminal':NC['terminal'],

def draw_node(nid):
    x,y,nt,label = NP[nid]
    col = node_col(nt)
    if nt == 'decision':
        # Diamond — wider for multi-line labels
        dw, dh = DW*1.1, DW*0.72
        pts = np.array([[x, y+dh],[x+dw, y],[x, y-dh],[x-dw, y]])
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon(pts, facecolor=col, edgecolor='white', lw=1.8, zorder=3))
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
                color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4, multialignment='center')
    else:
        eb = {'rollback':'#7F1D1D','terminal':'#14532D'}.get(nt,'white')
        elw= 1.8 if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 1.2
        bx = FancyBboxPatch((x-NW/2, y-NH/2), NW, NH,
                             boxstyle='round,pad=0.07', facecolor=col,
                             edgecolor=eb, linewidth=elw, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(bx)
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.0,
                color='white', zorder=4, multialignment='center',
                fontweight='bold' if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 'normal')

def node_pt(nid, dx, dy):
    x,y,nt,_ = NP[nid]
    if nt == 'decision':
        dw, dh = DW*1.1, DW*0.72
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy): return (x + np.sign(dx)*dw, y)
        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*dh)
    else:
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy): return (x + np.sign(dx)*NW/2, y)
        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*NH/2)

def arr(fr, to, etype, lbl='', rad=0.0, color=None):
    if fr not in NP or to not in NP: return
    x1,y1=NP[fr][:2]; x2,y2=NP[to][:2]
    dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
    if dx==0 and dy==0: return
    ec = color or EC.get(etype,'#374151')
    lw = 1.9 if etype in ('rollback','blue_green') else 1.3
    s1 = node_pt(fr, dx, dy)
    s2 = node_pt(to,-dx,-dy)
    ax.annotate('', xy=s2, xytext=s1, zorder=2,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ec, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad:.2f}'))

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 36, 22
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W); ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'

plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

# ── Geometry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LEFT   = 1.50        # label strip width
RIGHT  = 0.20
TITLE_H= 0.72
USABLE_W = FIG_W - LEFT - RIGHT

# 4 lanes occupy the area below title, each split: main row + sub row
LANE_MAIN = 2.00     # main node row height
LANE_SUB  = 1.10     # rollback / secondary row height
LANE_H    = LANE_MAIN + LANE_SUB
# HPA global zone sits between dev sub-row and staging main row
HPA_H = 0.90

# Total height budget
CONTENT_H = 4 * LANE_H + HPA_H
CHART_TOP = FIG_H - TITLE_H   # where lane 0 top starts

# Offsets — build from top
# lane_top[i] = top y of lane i
lane_top = [CHART_TOP - i * LANE_H for i in range(4)]
# Squeeze in HPA zone between dev (lane 0) and staging (lane 1)
# We override: dev sub-row, HPA zone, staging main row are packed tightly
DEV_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
DEV_RB_Y     = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
HPA_ZONE_Y   = (DEV_RB_Y + lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN) / 2   # midpoint
STAG_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
STAG_RB_Y    = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
CAN_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
CAN_RB_Y     = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
PROD_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
PROD_RB_Y    = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52

# Recompute with compact spacing
TITLE_TOP = FIG_H
# Stack: title(0.72), dev-main, dev-rb, hpa-zone, stag-main, stag-rb,
#        can-main, can-rb, prod-main+prod-sub(2 rows), prod-rb
ROW_H = {
    'dev_main':  2.00, 'dev_rb': 0.90,
    'hpa':       0.80,
    'stag_main': 2.00, 'stag_rb': 0.90,
    'can_main':  2.00, 'can_rb': 0.90,
    'prod_main': 1.30, 'prod_sub': 1.00, 'prod_rb': 0.90,
}
total_h = TITLE_H + sum(ROW_H.values())  # ~14.5

# Place rows
y = FIG_H - TITLE_H
def alloc(h):
    global y
    cy = y - h / 2
    y -= h
    return cy, y + h, y  # center, top, bottom

def alloc_band(h):
    global y; top = y; y -= h; return top, y

# reset
y = FIG_H - TITLE_H
dev_main_top, _ = alloc_band(ROW_H['dev_main'])
dev_rb_top, _   = alloc_band(ROW_H['dev_rb'])
hpa_top, _      = alloc_band(ROW_H['hpa'])
stag_main_top,_ = alloc_band(ROW_H['stag_main'])
stag_rb_top, _  = alloc_band(ROW_H['stag_rb'])
can_main_top, _ = alloc_band(ROW_H['can_main'])
can_rb_top, _   = alloc_band(ROW_H['can_rb'])
prod_main_top,_ = alloc_band(ROW_H['prod_main'])
prod_sub_top, _ = alloc_band(ROW_H['prod_sub'])
prod_rb_top, _  = alloc_band(ROW_H['prod_rb'])

def row_cy(top, h): return top - h/2

MY = {
    'dev':    row_cy(dev_main_top,  ROW_H['dev_main']),
    'dev_rb': row_cy(dev_rb_top,    ROW_H['dev_rb']),
    'hpa':    row_cy(hpa_top,       ROW_H['hpa']),
    'stag':   row_cy(stag_main_top, ROW_H['stag_main']),
    'stag_rb':row_cy(stag_rb_top,   ROW_H['stag_rb']),
    'can':    row_cy(can_main_top,  ROW_H['can_main']),
    'can_rb': row_cy(can_rb_top,    ROW_H['can_rb']),
    'prod':   row_cy(prod_main_top, ROW_H['prod_main']),
    'prod_s': row_cy(prod_sub_top,  ROW_H['prod_sub']),
    'prod_rb':row_cy(prod_rb_top,   ROW_H['prod_rb']),
}

# Swimlane band top/bottom (for rectangles)
bands = {
    'dev':        (dev_main_top, dev_rb_top - ROW_H['dev_rb']),
    'hpa_global': (hpa_top,      hpa_top - ROW_H['hpa']),
    'staging':    (stag_main_top,stag_rb_top - ROW_H['stag_rb']),
    'canary':     (can_main_top, can_rb_top  - ROW_H['can_rb']),
    'production': (prod_main_top,prod_rb_top - ROW_H['prod_rb']),
}

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_BG = {'dev':'#EFF6FF','staging':'#F0FDF4','canary':'#FFFBEB','production':'#FFF1F2'}
LANE_BD = {'dev':'#BFDBFE','staging':'#BBF7D0','canary':'#FDE68A','production':'#FECDD3'}
LANE_FG = {'dev':'#1E40AF','staging':'#166534','canary':'#92400E','production':'#9F1239'}
NC = {
    'action':'#2563EB','check':'#059669','decision':'#D97706',
    'hpa_dec':'#7C3AED','hpa_act':'#6D28D9','rollback':'#DC2626',
    'terminal':'#15803D','bg_action':'#1D4ED8',
}
EC = {'forward':'#374151','rollback':'#B91C1C','hpa':'#7C3AED','blue_green':'#1D4ED8'}

NW, NH = 1.72, 0.58   # node width/height
DW = 0.88             # diamond half-width

# ── Columns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_COLS = 22
def cx(c): return LEFT + (c + 0.5) * USABLE_W / N_COLS

# ── Node positions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NP = {
    # DEV
    'src-commit':    (cx(0),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'Source Commit\n& PR Merge'),
    'ci-build':      (cx(1),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'CI Build &\nUnit Tests'),
    'docker-push':   (cx(2),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'Docker Image\nBuild & Push'),
    'dev-deploy':    (cx(3),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'Deploy to Dev\nNamespace'),
    'dev-smoke':     (cx(4),  MY['dev'],    'check',    'Smoke Tests\n(Dev)'),
    'dev-hpa-check': (cx(5),  MY['dev'],    'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>60%|Mem>70%'),
    'dev-gate':      (cx(6),  MY['dev'],    'decision', 'Dev Health Gate\nerr < 5%'),
    'rollback-dev':  (cx(6),  MY['dev_rb'], 'rollback', 'Rollback Dev\nDeployment'),

    # STAGING
    'staging-deploy':      (cx(6),  MY['stag'],    'action',   'Deploy to Staging\nNamespace'),
    'staging-integration': (cx(7),  MY['stag'],    'check',    'Integration &\nE2E Tests'),
    'staging-hpa-check':   (cx(8),  MY['stag'],    'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>55%|Mem>65%'),
    'staging-perf':        (cx(9),  MY['stag'],    'check',    'Performance/\nLoad Tests'),
    'staging-gate':        (cx(10), MY['stag'],    'decision', 'Staging Health Gate\nerr < 2%'),
    'rollback-staging':    (cx(10), MY['stag_rb'], 'rollback', 'Rollback Staging\nDeployment'),

    # CANARY
    'canary-deploy':    (cx(10), MY['can'],    'action',   'Canary Deploy\n10% Traffic'),
    'canary-observe':   (cx(11), MY['can'],    'check',    'Observe\nMetrics 5min'),
    'canary-hpa-check': (cx(12), MY['can'],    'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>50%|Mem>60%'),
    'canary-ramp-25':   (cx(13), MY['can'],    'action',   'Ramp 25%\nTraffic'),
    'canary-observe-2': (cx(14), MY['can'],    'check',    'Observe\nMetrics 10min'),
    'canary-ramp-50':   (cx(15), MY['can'],    'action',   'Ramp 50%\nTraffic'),
    'canary-gate':      (cx(16), MY['can'],    'decision', 'Canary Gate\nerr<1%|p99<250ms'),
    'rollback-canary':  (cx(14), MY['can_rb'], 'rollback', 'Rollback Canary\n→Stable Traffic'),

    # PRODUCTION row 1 (main)
    'prod-prep':     (cx(16), MY['prod'],    'bg_action', 'Prepare\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-deploy-g': (cx(17), MY['prod'],    'bg_action', 'Deploy to\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-hc-green': (cx(18), MY['prod'],    'check',     'Green Slot\nHealth Check'),
    'prod-hpa':      (cx(19), MY['prod'],    'hpa_dec',   'HPA Check\nCPU>45%|Mem>55%'),
    'prod-bg-gate':  (cx(20), MY['prod'],    'decision',  'B/G Switch\nGate\nerr<0.5%\np99<200ms'),
    'prod-switch':   (cx(21), MY['prod'],    'bg_action', 'Switch 100%\nTraffic→Green'),

    # PRODUCTION row 2 (sub)
    'prod-verify':   (cx(21), MY['prod_s'],  'check',    'Post-Switch\nVerify 3min'),

    # GLOBAL HPA

# ── Draw lane bands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for lane, (top, bot) in [
    ('dev',        bands['dev']),

    rect = plt.Rectangle((0, bot), FIG_W, top-bot,

           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[lane]
    ax.text(0.75, (top+bot)/2, lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_FG[lane], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BD[lane], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*dh)
    else:
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy): return (x + np.sign(dx)*NW/2, y)
        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*NH/2)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 36, 22
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W); ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

# ── Geometry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LEFT   = 1.50        # label strip width
RIGHT  = 0.20
TITLE_H= 0.72
USABLE_W = FIG_W - LEFT - RIGHT

# 4 lanes occupy the area below title, each split: main row + sub row
LANE_MAIN = 2.00     # main node row height
LANE_SUB  = 1.10     # rollback / secondary row height
LANE_H    = LANE_MAIN + LANE_SUB
# HPA global zone sits between dev sub-row and staging main row
HPA_H = 0.90

# Total height budget
CONTENT_H = 4 * LANE_H + HPA_H
CHART_TOP = FIG_H - TITLE_H   # where lane 0 top starts

# Offsets — build from top
# lane_top[i] = top y of lane i
lane_top = [CHART_TOP - i * LANE_H for i in range(4)]
# Squeeze in HPA zone between dev (lane 0) and staging (lane 1)
# We override: dev sub-row, HPA zone, staging main row are packed tightly
DEV_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
DEV_RB_Y     = lane_top[0] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
HPA_ZONE_Y   = (DEV_RB_Y + lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN) / 2   # midpoint
STAG_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
STAG_RB_Y    = lane_top[1] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
CAN_MAIN_Y   = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
CAN_RB_Y     = lane_top[2] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52
PROD_MAIN_Y  = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN * 0.45
PROD_RB_Y    = lane_top[3] - LANE_MAIN - LANE_SUB * 0.52

# Recompute with compact spacing
TITLE_TOP = FIG_H
# Stack: title(0.72), dev-main, dev-rb, hpa-zone, stag-main, stag-rb,
#        can-main, can-rb, prod-main+prod-sub(2 rows), prod-rb
ROW_H = {
    'dev_main':  2.00, 'dev_rb': 0.90,
    'hpa':       0.80,
    'stag_main': 2.00, 'stag_rb': 0.90,
    'can_main':  2.00, 'can_rb': 0.90,
    'prod_main': 1.30, 'prod_sub': 1.00, 'prod_rb': 0.90,
}
total_h = TITLE_H + sum(ROW_H.values())  # ~14.5

# Place rows
y = FIG_H - TITLE_H
def alloc(h):
    global y
    cy = y - h / 2
    y -= h
    return cy, y + h, y  # center, top, bottom

def alloc_band(h):
    global y; top = y; y -= h; return top, y

# reset
y = FIG_H - TITLE_H
dev_main_top, _ = alloc_band(ROW_H['dev_main'])
dev_rb_top, _   = alloc_band(ROW_H['dev_rb'])
hpa_top, _      = alloc_band(ROW_H['hpa'])
stag_main_top,_ = alloc_band(ROW_H['stag_main'])
stag_rb_top, _  = alloc_band(ROW_H['stag_rb'])
can_main_top, _ = alloc_band(ROW_H['can_main'])
can_rb_top, _   = alloc_band(ROW_H['can_rb'])
prod_main_top,_ = alloc_band(ROW_H['prod_main'])
prod_sub_top, _ = alloc_band(ROW_H['prod_sub'])
prod_rb_top, _  = alloc_band(ROW_H['prod_rb'])

def row_cy(top, h): return top - h/2

MY = {
    'dev':    row_cy(dev_main_top,  ROW_H['dev_main']),
    'dev_rb': row_cy(dev_rb_top,    ROW_H['dev_rb']),
    'hpa':    row_cy(hpa_top,       ROW_H['hpa']),
    'stag':   row_cy(stag_main_top, ROW_H['stag_main']),
    'stag_rb':row_cy(stag_rb_top,   ROW_H['stag_rb']),
    'can':    row_cy(can_main_top,  ROW_H['can_main']),
    'can_rb': row_cy(can_rb_top,    ROW_H['can_rb']),
    'prod':   row_cy(prod_main_top, ROW_H['prod_main']),
    'prod_s': row_cy(prod_sub_top,  ROW_H['prod_sub']),
    'prod_rb':row_cy(prod_rb_top,   ROW_H['prod_rb']),
}

# Swimlane band top/bottom (for rectangles)
bands = {
    'dev':        (dev_main_top, dev_rb_top - ROW_H['dev_rb']),
    'hpa_global': (hpa_top,      hpa_top - ROW_H['hpa']),
    'staging':    (stag_main_top,stag_rb_top - ROW_H['stag_rb']),
    'canary':     (can_main_top, can_rb_top  - ROW_H['can_rb']),
    'production': (prod_main_top,prod_rb_top - ROW_H['prod_rb']),
}

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_BG = {'dev':'#EFF6FF','staging':'#F0FDF4','canary':'#FFFBEB','production':'#FFF1F2'}
LANE_BD = {'dev':'#BFDBFE','staging':'#BBF7D0','canary':'#FDE68A','production':'#FECDD3'}
LANE_FG = {'dev':'#1E40AF','staging':'#166534','canary':'#92400E','production':'#9F1239'}
NC = {
    'action':'#2563EB','check':'#059669','decision':'#D97706',
    'hpa_dec':'#7C3AED','hpa_act':'#6D28D9','rollback':'#DC2626',
    'terminal':'#15803D','bg_action':'#1D4ED8',
}
EC = {'forward':'#374151','rollback':'#B91C1C','hpa':'#7C3AED','blue_green':'#1D4ED8'}

NW, NH = 1.72, 0.58   # node width/height
DW = 0.88             # diamond half-width

# ── Columns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N_COLS = 22
def cx(c): return LEFT + (c + 0.5) * USABLE_W / N_COLS

# ── Node positions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NP = {
    # DEV
    'src-commit':    (cx(0),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'Source Commit\n& PR Merge'),
    'ci-build':      (cx(1),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'CI Build &\nUnit Tests'),
    'docker-push':   (cx(2),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'Docker Image\nBuild & Push'),
    'dev-deploy':    (cx(3),  MY['dev'],    'action',   'Deploy to Dev\nNamespace'),
    'dev-smoke':     (cx(4),  MY['dev'],    'check',    'Smoke Tests\n(Dev)'),
    'dev-hpa-check': (cx(5),  MY['dev'],    'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>60%|Mem>70%'),
    'dev-gate':      (cx(6),  MY['dev'],    'decision', 'Dev Health Gate\nerr < 5%'),
    'rollback-dev':  (cx(6),  MY['dev_rb'], 'rollback', 'Rollback Dev\nDeployment'),

    # STAGING
    'staging-deploy':      (cx(6),  MY['stag'],    'action',   'Deploy to Staging\nNamespace'),
    'staging-integration': (cx(7),  MY['stag'],    'check',    'Integration &\nE2E Tests'),
    'staging-hpa-check':   (cx(8),  MY['stag'],    'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>55%|Mem>65%'),
    'staging-perf':        (cx(9),  MY['stag'],    'check',    'Performance/\nLoad Tests'),
    'staging-gate':        (cx(10), MY['stag'],    'decision', 'Staging Health Gate\nerr < 2%'),
    'rollback-staging':    (cx(10), MY['stag_rb'], 'rollback', 'Rollback Staging\nDeployment'),

    # CANARY
    'canary-deploy':    (cx(10), MY['can'],    'action',   'Canary Deploy\n10% Traffic'),
    'canary-observe':   (cx(11), MY['can'],    'check',    'Observe\nMetrics 5min'),
    'canary-hpa-check': (cx(12), MY['can'],    'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>50%|Mem>60%'),
    'canary-ramp-25':   (cx(13), MY['can'],    'action',   'Ramp 25%\nTraffic'),
    'canary-observe-2': (cx(14), MY['can'],    'check',    'Observe\nMetrics 10min'),
    'canary-ramp-50':   (cx(15), MY['can'],    'action',   'Ramp 50%\nTraffic'),
    'canary-gate':      (cx(16), MY['can'],    'decision', 'Canary Gate\nerr<1%|p99<250ms'),
    'rollback-canary':  (cx(14), MY['can_rb'], 'rollback', 'Rollback Canary\n→Stable Traffic'),

    # PRODUCTION row 1 (main)
    'prod-prep':     (cx(16), MY['prod'],    'bg_action', 'Prepare\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-deploy-g': (cx(17), MY['prod'],    'bg_action', 'Deploy to\nGreen Slot'),
    'prod-hc-green': (cx(18), MY['prod'],    'check',     'Green Slot\nHealth Check'),
    'prod-hpa':      (cx(19), MY['prod'],    'hpa_dec',   'HPA Check\nCPU>45%|Mem>55%'),
    'prod-bg-gate':  (cx(20), MY['prod'],    'decision',  'B/G Switch\nGate\nerr<0.5%\np99<200ms'),
    'prod-switch':   (cx(21), MY['prod'],    'bg_action', 'Switch 100%\nTraffic→Green'),

    # PRODUCTION row 2 (sub)
    'prod-verify':   (cx(21), MY['prod_s'],  'check',    'Post-Switch\nVerify 3min'),
    'prod-finalize': (cx(20), MY['prod_s'],  'action',   'Decommission\nBlue Slot'),
    'prod-complete': (cx(19), MY['prod_s'],  'terminal', 'Pipeline\nComplete ✓'),

    # PRODUCTION rollback
    'rollback-prod': (cx(20), MY['prod_rb'], 'rollback', 'Rollback:\nRevert Traffic→Blue'),

    # GLOBAL HPA
    'hpa-up':   (cx(5),   MY['hpa'], 'hpa_act', 'HPA: Scale Up\nReplicas'),
    'hpa-down': (cx(6.8), MY['hpa'], 'hpa_act', 'HPA: Scale Down\nReplicas'),
    'alert':    (cx(9),   MY['hpa'], 'action',  'Alert On-Call\n& Open Incident'),
}

# ── Draw lane bands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for lane, (top, bot) in [
    ('dev',        bands['dev']),
    ('staging',    bands['staging']),
    ('canary',     bands['canary']),
    ('production', bands['production']),
]:
    rect = plt.Rectangle((0, bot), FIG_W, top-bot,
                          facecolor=LANE_BG[lane], edgecolor=LANE_BD[lane],
                          linewidth=1.8, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    lbl = {'dev':'DEV\napp-dev','staging':'STAGING\napp-staging',
           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[lane]
    ax.text(0.75, (top+bot)/2, lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_FG[lane], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BD[lane], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

# HPA Global zone
hpa_top2, hpa_bot2 = bands['hpa_global']
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((LEFT, hpa_bot2), FIG_W-LEFT-RIGHT, hpa_top2-hpa_bot2,
    facecolor='#EDE9FE', edgecolor='#C4B5FD', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', zorder=0.5, alpha=0.8))
ax.text(LEFT+0.08, MY['hpa'], 'HPA / GLOBAL', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, color='#5B21B6', style='italic', fontweight='bold', zorder=1)

# ── Node drawing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def node_col(nt):
    return {'action':NC['action'],'check':NC['check'],'decision':NC['decision'],
            'hpa_dec':NC['hpa_dec'],'hpa_act':NC['hpa_act'],
            'rollback':NC['rollback'],'terminal':NC['terminal'],
            'bg_action':NC['bg_action']}.get(nt,'#6B7280')

def draw_node(nid):
    x,y,nt,label = NP[nid]
    col = node_col(nt)
    if nt == 'decision':
        # Diamond — wider for multi-line labels
        dw, dh = DW*1.1, DW*0.72
        pts = np.array([[x, y+dh],[x+dw, y],[x, y-dh],[x-dw, y]])
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon(pts, facecolor=col, edgecolor='white', lw=1.8, zorder=3))
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
                color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4, multialignment='center')
    else:
        eb = {'rollback':'#7F1D1D','terminal':'#14532D'}.get(nt,'white')
        elw= 1.8 if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 1.2
        bx = FancyBboxPatch((x-NW/2, y-NH/2), NW, NH,
                             boxstyle='round,pad=0.07', facecolor=col,
                             edgecolor=eb, linewidth=elw, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(bx)
        ax.text(x, y, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.0,
                color='white', zorder=4, multialignment='center',
                fontweight='bold' if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 'normal')

def node_pt(nid, dx, dy):
    x,y,nt,_ = NP[nid]
    if nt == 'decision':
        dw, dh = DW*1.1, DW*0.72
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy): return (x + np.sign(dx)*dw, y)
        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*dh)
    else:
        if abs(dx) >= abs(dy): return (x + np.sign(dx)*NW/2, y)
        else:                   return (x, y + np.sign(dy)*NH/2)

# ── Arrows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    x1,y1=NP[fr][:2]; x2,y2=NP[to][:2]
    dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
    if dx==0 and dy==0: return
    ec = color or EC.get(etype,'#374151')
    lw = 1.9 if etype in ('rollback','blue_green') else 1.3
    s1 = node_pt(fr, dx, dy)
    s2 = node_pt(to,-dx,-dy)
    ax.annotate('', xy=s2, xytext=s1, zorder=2,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ec, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad:.2f}'))

        ax.text(mx, my+0.06, lbl, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=4.8, color=ec, zorder=5,
                bbox=dict(facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.78, pad=0.8))

arr('src-commit','ci-build','forward')
arr('ci-build','docker-push','forward','tests pass')

# STAGING flow
arr('staging-deploy','staging-integration','forward')

arr('staging-hpa-check','staging-perf','forward','in range')

arr('staging-hpa-check','hpa-down','hpa','CPU<20%', rad=0.25)

# CANARY flow
arr('canary-deploy','canary-observe','forward')
arr('canary-observe','canary-hpa-check','forward','ok')

# PRODUCTION blue-green

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 38, 24
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W); ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

LEFT = 1.55; RIGHT = 0.25
USABLE_W = FIG_W - LEFT - RIGHT
NW, NH = 1.80, 0.60   # node width / height
DW, DH = 0.92, 0.62   # diamond half-widths

N_COLS = 23
def cx(c): return LEFT + (c + 0.5) * USABLE_W / N_COLS

# ── Row centers (y) — top to bottom ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Title bar at top, then rows stacked downward
TITLE_TOP = FIG_H - 0.75
# Row heights:
RH = dict(dev=2.10, dev_rb=1.00, hpa=0.90,
          stag=2.10, stag_rb=1.00,
          can=2.10,  can_rb=1.00,
          prod=1.80, prod2=1.40, prod_rb=1.00)

y = TITLE_TOP
def consume(key):
    global y; h = RH[key]; cy = y - h/2; y -= h; return cy, y+h, y

dev_cy,   dev_top,   dev_bot    = consume('dev')
dev_rb_cy,dev_rb_top,dev_rb_bot = consume('dev_rb')
hpa_cy,   hpa_top,   hpa_bot    = consume('hpa')
stag_cy,  stag_top,  stag_bot   = consume('stag')
srb_cy,   srb_top,   srb_bot    = consume('stag_rb')
can_cy,   can_top,   can_bot    = consume('can')
crb_cy,   crb_top,   crb_bot    = consume('can_rb')
prod_cy,  prod_top,  prod_bot   = consume('prod')
prod2_cy, prod2_top, prod2_bot  = consume('prod2')
prb_cy,   prb_top,   prb_bot    = consume('prod_rb')
LEGEND_TOP = y

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_BG = {'dev':'#EFF6FF','staging':'#F0FDF4','canary':'#FFFBEB','production':'#FFF1F2'}
LANE_BD = {'dev':'#BFDBFE','staging':'#BBF7D0','canary':'#FDE68A','production':'#FECDD3'}
LANE_FG = {'dev':'#1E40AF','staging':'#166534','canary':'#92400E','production':'#9F1239'}
NC = {'action':'#2563EB','check':'#059669','decision':'#D97706',
      'hpa_dec':'#7C3AED','hpa_act':'#6D28D9','rollback':'#DC2626',
      'terminal':'#15803D','bg_action':'#1D4ED8'}
EC = {'forward':'#374151','rollback':'#B91C1C','hpa':'#7C3AED','blue_green':'#1D4ED8'}

# ── Lane bands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for name, top, bot in [
    ('dev',        dev_top,  dev_rb_bot),
    ('staging',    stag_top, srb_bot),
    ('canary',     can_top,  crb_bot),
    ('production', prod_top, prb_bot),
]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0, bot), FIG_W, top-bot,
        facecolor=LANE_BG[name], edgecolor=LANE_BD[name], linewidth=1.8, zorder=0))
    lbl = {'dev':'DEV\napp-dev','staging':'STAGING\napp-staging',
           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[name]
    ax.text(0.78, (top+bot)/2, lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_FG[name], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BD[name], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

# HPA global band
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((LEFT, hpa_bot), FIG_W-LEFT-RIGHT, hpa_top-hpa_bot,
    facecolor='#EDE9FE', edgecolor='#C4B5FD', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', zorder=0.5, alpha=0.8))
ax.text(LEFT+0.08, hpa_cy, 'HPA / GLOBAL', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, color='#5B21B6', style='italic', fontweight='bold', zorder=1)

# ── Node map ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NP = {
    'src-commit':    (cx(0),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Source Commit\n& PR Merge'),
    'ci-build':      (cx(1),  dev_cy,   'action',   'CI Build &\nUnit Tests'),
    'docker-push':   (cx(2),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Docker Image\nBuild & Push'),
    'dev-deploy':    (cx(3),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Deploy to Dev\nNamespace'),
    'dev-smoke':     (cx(4),  dev_cy,   'check',    'Smoke Tests\n(Dev)'),
    'dev-hpa':       (cx(5),  dev_cy,   'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>60%|Mem>70%'),
    'dev-gate':      (cx(6),  dev_cy,   'decision', 'Dev Health Gate\nerr < 5%'),
    'rollback-dev':  (cx(6),  dev_rb_cy,'rollback', 'Rollback Dev\nDeployment'),

    'stag-deploy':   (cx(6),  stag_cy,  'action',   'Deploy to Staging\nNamespace'),
    'stag-int':      (cx(7),  stag_cy,  'check',    'Integration &\nE2E Tests'),
    'stag-hpa':      (cx(8),  stag_cy,  'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>55%|Mem>65%'),
    'stag-perf':     (cx(9),  stag_cy,  'check',    'Performance/\nLoad Tests'),
