import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 38, 24
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W); ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

LEFT = 1.55; RIGHT = 0.25
USABLE_W = FIG_W - LEFT - RIGHT
NW, NH = 1.80, 0.60   # node width / height
DW, DH = 0.92, 0.62   # diamond half-widths

N_COLS = 23
def cx(c): return LEFT + (c + 0.5) * USABLE_W / N_COLS

# ── Row centers (y) — top to bottom ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Title bar at top, then rows stacked downward
TITLE_TOP = FIG_H - 0.75
# Row heights:
RH = dict(dev=2.10, dev_rb=1.00, hpa=0.90,
          stag=2.10, stag_rb=1.00,
          can=2.10,  can_rb=1.00,
          prod=1.80, prod2=1.40, prod_rb=1.00)

y = TITLE_TOP
def consume(key):
    global y; h = RH[key]; cy = y - h/2; y -= h; return cy, y+h, y

dev_cy,   dev_top,   dev_bot    = consume('dev')
dev_rb_cy,dev_rb_top,dev_rb_bot = consume('dev_rb')
hpa_cy,   hpa_top,   hpa_bot    = consume('hpa')
stag_cy,  stag_top,  stag_bot   = consume('stag')
srb_cy,   srb_top,   srb_bot    = consume('stag_rb')
can_cy,   can_top,   can_bot    = consume('can')
crb_cy,   crb_top,   crb_bot    = consume('can_rb')
prod_cy,  prod_top,  prod_bot   = consume('prod')
prod2_cy, prod2_top, prod2_bot  = consume('prod2')
prb_cy,   prb_top,   prb_bot    = consume('prod_rb')
LEGEND_TOP = y

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_BG = {'dev':'#EFF6FF','staging':'#F0FDF4','canary':'#FFFBEB','production':'#FFF1F2'}
LANE_BD = {'dev':'#BFDBFE','staging':'#BBF7D0','canary':'#FDE68A','production':'#FECDD3'}
LANE_FG = {'dev':'#1E40AF','staging':'#166534','canary':'#92400E','production':'#9F1239'}
NC = {'action':'#2563EB','check':'#059669','decision':'#D97706',
      'hpa_dec':'#7C3AED','hpa_act':'#6D28D9','rollback':'#DC2626',
      'terminal':'#15803D','bg_action':'#1D4ED8'}
EC = {'forward':'#374151','rollback':'#B91C1C','hpa':'#7C3AED','blue_green':'#1D4ED8'}

# ── Lane bands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for name, top, bot in [
    ('dev',        dev_top,  dev_rb_bot),
    ('staging',    stag_top, srb_bot),
    ('canary',     can_top,  crb_bot),
    ('production', prod_top, prb_bot),
]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0, bot), FIG_W, top-bot,
        facecolor=LANE_BG[name], edgecolor=LANE_BD[name], linewidth=1.8, zorder=0))
    lbl = {'dev':'DEV\napp-dev','staging':'STAGING\napp-staging',
           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[name]
    ax.text(0.78, (top+bot)/2, lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_FG[name], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BD[name], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

# HPA global band
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((LEFT, hpa_bot), FIG_W-LEFT-RIGHT, hpa_top-hpa_bot,
    facecolor='#EDE9FE', edgecolor='#C4B5FD', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', zorder=0.5, alpha=0.8))
ax.text(LEFT+0.08, hpa_cy, 'HPA / GLOBAL', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, color='#5B21B6', style='italic', fontweight='bold', zorder=1)

# ── Node map ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NP = {
    'src-commit':    (cx(0),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Source Commit\n& PR Merge'),
    'ci-build':      (cx(1),  dev_cy,   'action',   'CI Build &\nUnit Tests'),
    'docker-push':   (cx(2),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Docker Image\nBuild & Push'),
    'dev-deploy':    (cx(3),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Deploy to Dev\nNamespace'),
    'dev-smoke':     (cx(4),  dev_cy,   'check',    'Smoke Tests\n(Dev)'),
    'dev-hpa':       (cx(5),  dev_cy,   'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>60%|Mem>70%'),
    'dev-gate':      (cx(6),  dev_cy,   'decision', 'Dev Health Gate\nerr < 5%'),
    'rollback-dev':  (cx(6),  dev_rb_cy,'rollback', 'Rollback Dev\nDeployment'),

    'stag-deploy':   (cx(6),  stag_cy,  'action',   'Deploy to Staging\nNamespace'),

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 38, 24
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W); ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
BG = '#F1F5F9'
ax.set_facecolor(BG); fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans'})

LEFT = 1.55; RIGHT = 0.25
USABLE_W = FIG_W - LEFT - RIGHT
NW, NH = 1.80, 0.60   # node width / height
DW, DH = 0.92, 0.62   # diamond half-widths

N_COLS = 23
def cx(c): return LEFT + (c + 0.5) * USABLE_W / N_COLS

# ── Row centers (y) — top to bottom ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Title bar at top, then rows stacked downward
TITLE_TOP = FIG_H - 0.75
# Row heights:
RH = dict(dev=2.10, dev_rb=1.00, hpa=0.90,
          stag=2.10, stag_rb=1.00,
          can=2.10,  can_rb=1.00,
          prod=1.80, prod2=1.40, prod_rb=1.00)

y = TITLE_TOP
def consume(key):
    global y; h = RH[key]; cy = y - h/2; y -= h; return cy, y+h, y

dev_cy,   dev_top,   dev_bot    = consume('dev')
dev_rb_cy,dev_rb_top,dev_rb_bot = consume('dev_rb')
hpa_cy,   hpa_top,   hpa_bot    = consume('hpa')
stag_cy,  stag_top,  stag_bot   = consume('stag')
srb_cy,   srb_top,   srb_bot    = consume('stag_rb')
can_cy,   can_top,   can_bot    = consume('can')
crb_cy,   crb_top,   crb_bot    = consume('can_rb')
prod_cy,  prod_top,  prod_bot   = consume('prod')
prod2_cy, prod2_top, prod2_bot  = consume('prod2')
prb_cy,   prb_top,   prb_bot    = consume('prod_rb')
LEGEND_TOP = y

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_BG = {'dev':'#EFF6FF','staging':'#F0FDF4','canary':'#FFFBEB','production':'#FFF1F2'}
LANE_BD = {'dev':'#BFDBFE','staging':'#BBF7D0','canary':'#FDE68A','production':'#FECDD3'}
LANE_FG = {'dev':'#1E40AF','staging':'#166534','canary':'#92400E','production':'#9F1239'}
NC = {'action':'#2563EB','check':'#059669','decision':'#D97706',
      'hpa_dec':'#7C3AED','hpa_act':'#6D28D9','rollback':'#DC2626',
      'terminal':'#15803D','bg_action':'#1D4ED8'}
EC = {'forward':'#374151','rollback':'#B91C1C','hpa':'#7C3AED','blue_green':'#1D4ED8'}

# ── Lane bands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for name, top, bot in [
    ('dev',        dev_top,  dev_rb_bot),
    ('staging',    stag_top, srb_bot),
    ('canary',     can_top,  crb_bot),
    ('production', prod_top, prb_bot),
]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0, bot), FIG_W, top-bot,
        facecolor=LANE_BG[name], edgecolor=LANE_BD[name], linewidth=1.8, zorder=0))
    lbl = {'dev':'DEV\napp-dev','staging':'STAGING\napp-staging',
           'canary':'CANARY\napp-canary','production':'PRODUCTION\napp-production'}[name]
    ax.text(0.78, (top+bot)/2, lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=LANE_FG[name], zorder=1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=LANE_BD[name], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9))

# HPA global band
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((LEFT, hpa_bot), FIG_W-LEFT-RIGHT, hpa_top-hpa_bot,
    facecolor='#EDE9FE', edgecolor='#C4B5FD', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', zorder=0.5, alpha=0.8))
ax.text(LEFT+0.08, hpa_cy, 'HPA / GLOBAL', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, color='#5B21B6', style='italic', fontweight='bold', zorder=1)

# ── Node map ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NP = {
    'src-commit':    (cx(0),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Source Commit\n& PR Merge'),
    'ci-build':      (cx(1),  dev_cy,   'action',   'CI Build &\nUnit Tests'),
    'docker-push':   (cx(2),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Docker Image\nBuild & Push'),
    'dev-deploy':    (cx(3),  dev_cy,   'action',   'Deploy to Dev\nNamespace'),
    'dev-smoke':     (cx(4),  dev_cy,   'check',    'Smoke Tests\n(Dev)'),
    'dev-hpa':       (cx(5),  dev_cy,   'hpa_dec',  'HPA Check\nCPU>60%|Mem>70%'),
    'dev-gate':      (cx(6),  dev_cy,   'decision', 'Dev Health Gate\nerr < 5%'),
    'rollback-dev':  (cx(6),  dev_rb_cy,'rollback', 'Rollback Dev\nDeployment'),

def draw(nid):
    x,y,nt,lbl = NP[nid]
    col = ncol(nt)
    if nt == 'decision':
        pts = np.array([[x, y+DH],[x+DW, y],[x, y-DH],[x-DW, y]])
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon(pts, facecolor=col, edgecolor='white', lw=1.8, zorder=3))
        ax.text(x, y, lbl, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
                color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=4, multialignment='center')
    else:
        eb = {'rollback':'#7F1D1D','terminal':'#14532D'}.get(nt,'white')
        elw = 2.0 if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 1.2
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x-NW/2,y-NH/2), NW, NH,
            boxstyle='round,pad=0.07', facecolor=col, edgecolor=eb, linewidth=elw, zorder=3))
        ax.text(x, y, lbl, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.0,
                color='white', zorder=4, multialignment='center',
                fontweight='bold' if nt in ('rollback','terminal') else 'normal')

def npt(nid, dx, dy):
    x,y,nt,_ = NP[nid]
    if nt=='decision':
        return (x+np.sign(dx)*DW, y) if abs(dx)>=abs(dy) else (x, y+np.sign(dy)*DH)
    return (x+np.sign(dx)*NW/2, y) if abs(dx)>=abs(dy) else (x, y+np.sign(dy)*NH/2)

    dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
    if dx==0 and dy==0: return
    ec=EC.get(etype,'#374151')
    lw=1.9 if etype in ('rollback','blue_green') else 1.3
    s1=npt(fr,dx,dy); s2=npt(to,-dx,-dy)
    ax.annotate('', xy=s2, xytext=s1, zorder=2,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ec, lw=lw,
